ValidationRule.description: Must have Contract Record Created and Linked to Complete
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", RecordType.Name != 'Bank-PSP Partner', RecordType.Name != 'Strategic Partner', RecordType.Name != 'Agents', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Statement of Work')), Probability >0.95, OR ( ContractId = "", ISBLANK(Contract.ActivatedDate), ISBLANK(TEXT(Contract.Flywire_Entity__c)), ISBLANK(Contract.StartDate), ISBLANK(Contract.EndDate) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ***. Link the Contract Record to Opp, Ensure all Fields are filled in AND it has been Activated by clicking the 'Activate' Button. ***
